verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν μιᾷ τῶν ἡμερῶν αὐτοῦ διδάσκοντος τὸν λαὸν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ εὐαγγελιζομένου οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς σὺν τοῖς πρεσβυτέροις ἐπέστησαν
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto en mia tōn hēmerōn autou didaskontos ton laon en tō hierō kai euangelizomenou hoi archiereis kai hoi grammateis syn tois presbyterois epestēsan
verses.literal: - - - One - day [as Jesus] was teaching the people in the temple [courts] and proclaiming the gospel the chief priests and - scribes together with the elders came up [to Him]

verses.original: Εἰπὸν ἡμῖν καὶ εἶπαν λέγοντες πρὸς αὐτόν ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ποιεῖς ταῦτα ἢ τίς ἐστιν ὁ δούς σοι ταύτην τὴν ἐξουσίαν
verses.transliteration: Eipon hēmin kai eipan legontes pros auton en poia exousia poieis tauta ē tis estin ho dous soi tautēn tēn exousian
verses.literal: Tell us - - they said - - by what authority are You doing these things [and] who - - gave You this - authority

verses.original: κἀγὼ Ἐρωτήσω ὑμᾶς λόγον δὲ Ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς καὶ εἴπατέ μοι
verses.transliteration: kagō Erōtēsō hymas logon de Apokritheis eipen pros autous kai eipate moi
verses.literal: vvv I will also ask you a question - - [Jesus] replied - - - Tell Me

verses.original: Ἰωάννου Τὸ βάπτισμα ἦν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἢ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: Iōannou To baptisma ēn ex ouranou ē ex anthrōpōn
verses.literal: John’s - baptism was it from heaven or from men

verses.original: δὲ Οἱ συνελογίσαντο πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς λέγοντες ὅτι Ἐὰν εἴπωμεν Ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἐρεῖ Διὰ τί οὐκ ἐπιστεύσατε αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: de Hoi synelogisanto pros heautous legontes hoti Ean eipōmen Ex ouranou erei Dia ti ouk episteusate autō
verses.literal: - - They deliberated among themselves [and] said - If we say From heaven He will ask Why . . . vvv did you not believe him

verses.original: δὲ ἐὰν εἴπωμεν Ἐξ ἀνθρώπων ἅπας ὁ λαὸς καταλιθάσει ἡμᾶς γάρ ἐστιν πεπεισμένος Ἰωάννην εἶναι προφήτην
verses.transliteration: de ean eipōmen Ex anthrōpōn hapas ho laos katalithasei hēmas gar estin pepeismenos Iōannēn einai prophētēn
verses.literal: But if we say From men all the people will stone us for they are convinced [that] John was a prophet

verses.original: Καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν μὴ εἰδέναι πόθεν
verses.transliteration: Kai apekrithēsan mē eidenai pothen
verses.literal: So they answered [that] vvv they did not know where [it was] from

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Οὐδὲ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ποιῶ ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Iēsous eipen autois Oude egō legō hymin en poia exousia poiō tauta
verses.literal: And - Jesus replied . . . Neither {will} I tell you by what authority I am doing these things

verses.original: δὲ Ἤρξατο λέγειν πρὸς τὸν λαὸν ταύτην τὴν παραβολὴν τις Ἄνθρωπος ἐφύτευσεν ἀμπελῶνα καὶ ἐξέδετο αὐτὸν γεωργοῖς καὶ ἀπεδήμησεν ἱκανούς χρόνους
verses.transliteration: de Ērxato legein pros ton laon tautēn tēn parabolēn tis Anthrōpos ephyteusen ampelōna kai exedeto auton geōrgois kai apedēmēsen hikanous chronous
verses.literal: Then He proceeded to tell - the people this - parable A man planted a vineyard - rented it {out} to [some] tenants and went away for a long time

verses.original: καὶ καιρῷ ἀπέστειλεν δοῦλον πρὸς τοὺς γεωργοὺς ἵνα δώσουσιν αὐτῷ ἀπὸ τοῦ καρποῦ τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος δὲ οἱ γεωργοὶ δείραντες ἐξαπέστειλαν αὐτὸν κενόν
verses.transliteration: kai kairō apesteilen doulon pros tous geōrgous hina dōsousin autō apo tou karpou tou ampelōnos de hoi geōrgoi deirantes exapesteilan auton kenon
verses.literal: - At harvest time he sent a servant to the tenants to collect . . . [his share] of the fruit of the vineyard But the tenants beat [the servant] [and] sent him away . . . empty-handed

verses.original: Καὶ προσέθετο πέμψαι ἕτερον δοῦλον δὲ οἱ δείραντες καὶ ἀτιμάσαντες κἀκεῖνον ἐξαπέστειλαν κενόν
verses.transliteration: Kai prosetheto pempsai heteron doulon de hoi deirantes kai atimasantes kakeinon exapesteilan kenon
verses.literal: [So] vvv he sent another servant but - they beat [him] and treated him shamefully . . . sending [him] away empty-handed

verses.original: Καὶ προσέθετο πέμψαι τρίτον δὲ καὶ οἱ τραυματίσαντες τοῦτον ἐξέβαλον
verses.transliteration: Kai prosetheto pempsai triton de kai hoi traumatisantes touton exebalon
verses.literal: Then vvv he sent a third but . . . - they wounded him [and] threw [him] out

verses.original: Τί ποιήσω δὲ Εἶπεν ὁ κύριος τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος πέμψω μου τὸν ἀγαπητόν τὸν υἱόν ἴσως ἐντραπήσονται τοῦτον
verses.transliteration: Ti poiēsō de Eipen ho kyrios tou ampelōnos pempsō mou ton agapēton ton huion isōs entrapēsontai touton
verses.literal: What shall I do - asked the owner of the vineyard I will send my - beloved - son Perhaps they will respect him

verses.original: δὲ οἱ γεωργοὶ Ἰδόντες αὐτὸν διελογίζοντο πρὸς ἀλλήλους λέγοντες Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ κληρονόμος ἀποκτείνωμεν αὐτόν ἵνα ἡ κληρονομία γένηται ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: de hoi geōrgoi Idontes auton dielogizonto pros allēlous legontes Houtos estin ho klēronomos apokteinōmen auton hina hē klēronomia genētai hēmōn
verses.literal: But when the tenants saw [the son] they discussed it among themselves [and] said This is the heir Let us kill him [and] the inheritance will be ours

verses.original: καὶ ἐκβαλόντες αὐτὸν ἔξω τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος ἀπέκτειναν Τί οὖν ὁ κύριος τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος ποιήσει αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai ekbalontes auton exō tou ampelōnos apekteinan Ti oun ho kyrios tou ampelōnos poiēsei autois
verses.literal: So they threw him out of the vineyard [and] killed [him] What then {will} the owner of the vineyard do to them

verses.original: ἐλεύσεται καὶ ἀπολέσει τούτους τοὺς γεωργοὺς καὶ δώσει τὸν ἀμπελῶνα ἄλλοις δὲ Ἀκούσαντες εἶπαν Μὴ γένοιτο
verses.transliteration: eleusetai kai apolesei toutous tous geōrgous kai dōsei ton ampelōna allois de Akousantes eipan Mē genoito
verses.literal: He will come and kill those - tenants and give the vineyard to others And [when the people] heard [this] they said vvv May such a thing never happen

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ ἐμβλέψας αὐτοῖς εἶπεν οὖν Τί ἐστιν τοῦτο τὸ γεγραμμένον Λίθον ὃν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες ἀπεδοκίμασαν Οὗτος ἐγενήθη εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας
verses.transliteration: de Ho emblepsas autois eipen oun Ti estin touto to gegrammenon Lithon hon hoi oikodomountes apedokimasan Houtos egenēthē eis kephalēn gōnias
verses.literal: But - [Jesus] looked directly at them [and] said Then what is the meaning of that which is written [The] stone - the builders rejected - has become . . . [the] cornerstone . . .

verses.original: Πᾶς ὁ πεσὼν ἐπ’ ἐκεῖνον τὸν λίθον συνθλασθήσεται δ’ ἐφ’ ὃν ἂν πέσῃ λικμήσει αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Pas ho pesōn ep’ ekeinon ton lithon synthlasthēsetai d’ eph’ hon an pesē likmēsei auton
verses.literal: Everyone - who falls on this - stone will be broken to pieces but vvv he on whom . . . it falls will be crushed . . .

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς γὰρ ἔγνωσαν ὅτι εἶπεν ταύτην τὴν παραβολὴν πρὸς αὐτοὺς ἐζήτησαν ἐπιβαλεῖν τὰς χεῖρας ἐπ’ αὐτὸν ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν τὸν λαόν
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi grammateis kai hoi archiereis gar egnōsan hoti eipen tautēn tēn parabolēn pros autous ezētēsan epibalein tas cheiras ep’ auton en autē tē hōra kai ephobēthēsan ton laon
verses.literal: [When] the scribes and - chief priests - realized that [Jesus] had spoken this - parable against them they sought to arrest . . . . . . . . . Him vvv that very - hour But they were afraid of the people

verses.original: Καὶ παρατηρήσαντες ἀπέστειλαν ἐνκαθέτους ὑποκρινομένους ἑαυτοὺς εἶναι δικαίους ἵνα ἐπιλάβωνται αὐτοῦ λόγου ὥστε παραδοῦναι αὐτὸν τῇ ἀρχῇ καὶ τῇ ἐξουσίᾳ τοῦ ἡγεμόνος
verses.transliteration: Kai paratērēsantes apesteilan enkathetous hypokrinomenous heautous einai dikaious hina epilabōntai autou logou hōste paradounai auton tē archē kai tē exousia tou hēgemonos
verses.literal: So they watched [Him] closely [and] sent spies who pretended - to be sincere They were hoping to catch [Him] in His words in order to hand Him over . . . to the rule and - authority of the governor

verses.original: Διδάσκαλε καὶ ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν λέγοντες οἴδαμεν ὅτι λέγεις καὶ διδάσκεις ὀρθῶς καὶ οὐ λαμβάνεις πρόσωπον ἀλλ’ διδάσκεις τὴν ὁδὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐπ’ ἀληθείας
verses.transliteration: Didaskale kai epērōtēsan auton legontes oidamen hoti legeis kai didaskeis orthōs kai ou lambaneis prosōpon all’ didaskeis tēn hodon tou Theou ep’ alētheias
verses.literal: Teacher - they inquired . . . . . . we know that You speak and teach correctly - You show no partiality . . . . . . but teach the way - of God in accordance with the truth

verses.original: ἔξεστιν ἡμᾶς δοῦναι φόρον Καίσαρι ἢ οὔ
verses.transliteration: exestin hēmas dounai phoron Kaisari ē ou
verses.literal: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not

verses.original: δὲ Κατανοήσας αὐτῶν τὴν πανουργίαν εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: de Katanoēsas autōn tēn panourgian eipen pros autous
verses.literal: But [Jesus] saw through their - duplicity [and] said to them

verses.original: Δείξατέ μοι δηνάριον τίνος εἰκόνα καὶ ἐπιγραφήν ἔχει Καίσαρος δὲ Οἱ εἶπαν
verses.transliteration: Deixate moi dēnarion tinos eikona kai epigraphēn echei Kaisaros de Hoi eipan
verses.literal: Show Me a denarius Whose image and inscription are on it Caesar’s - - they answered

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Τοίνυν εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς ἀπόδοτε Καίσαρι τὰ Καίσαρος καὶ τῷ Θεῷ τὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: de Ho Toinyn eipen pros autous apodote Kaisari ta Kaisaros kai tō Theō ta tou Theou
verses.literal: - - So [Jesus] told . . . them Give to Caesar what [is] Caesar’s and - to God what [is] - God’s

verses.original: Καὶ οὐκ ἴσχυσαν ἐπιλαβέσθαι αὐτοῦ ῥήματος ἐναντίον τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ θαυμάσαντες ἐπὶ αὐτοῦ τῇ ἀποκρίσει ἐσίγησαν
verses.transliteration: Kai ouk ischysan epilabesthai autou rhēmatos enantion tou laou kai thaumasantes epi autou tē apokrisei esigēsan
verses.literal: And vvv they were unable to trap Him in His words before the people And amazed at His - answer they fell silent

verses.original: δέ τινες τῶν Σαδδουκαίων οἱ ἀντιλέγοντες μὴ εἶναι ἀνάστασιν Προσελθόντες ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: de tines tōn Saddoukaiōn hoi antilegontes mē einai anastasin Proselthontes epērōtēsan auton
verses.literal: Then some of the Sadducees who say there is no . . . . . . resurrection came to question Him

verses.original: Διδάσκαλε λέγοντες Μωϋσῆς ἔγραψεν ἡμῖν ἐάν τινος ἀδελφὸς ἀποθάνῃ ἔχων γυναῖκα καὶ οὗτος ᾖ ἄτεκνος ἵνα αὐτοῦ ὁ ἀδελφὸς λάβῃ τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ ἐξαναστήσῃ σπέρμα τῷ αὐτοῦ ἀδελφῷ
verses.transliteration: Didaskale legontes Mōusēs egrapsen hēmin ean tinos adelphos apothanē echōn gynaika kai houtos ē ateknos hina autou ho adelphos labē tēn gynaika kai exanastēsē sperma tō autou adelphō
verses.literal: Teacher they said Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies [and] leaves a wife but vvv vvv no children - vvv vvv [the man] is to marry [his brother’s] [widow] and raise up offspring for vvv [him]

verses.original: οὖν ἦσαν ἑπτὰ ἀδελφοὶ καὶ ὁ πρῶτος λαβὼν γυναῖκα ἀπέθανεν ἄτεκνος
verses.transliteration: oun ēsan hepta adelphoi kai ho prōtos labōn gynaika apethanen ateknos
verses.literal: Now there were seven brothers - The first [one] married a wife [but] died childless

verses.original: καὶ ὁ δεύτερος
verses.transliteration: kai ho deuteros
verses.literal: Then the second

verses.original: καὶ ὁ τρίτος ἔλαβεν αὐτήν δὲ ὡσαύτως καὶ οἱ ἑπτὰ καὶ ἀπέθανον κατέλιπον οὐ τέκνα
verses.transliteration: kai ho tritos elaben autēn de hōsautōs kai hoi hepta kai apethanon katelipon ou tekna
verses.literal: and the third married [the widow] and in the same way . . . [all] seven - died leaving no children

verses.original: καὶ ὕστερον ἡ γυνὴ ἀπέθανεν
verses.transliteration: kai hysteron hē gynē apethanen
verses.literal: And last of all the woman died

verses.original: οὖν ἐν τῇ ἀναστάσει ἡ γυνὴ τίνος αὐτῶν γυνή γίνεται γὰρ οἱ ἑπτὰ ἔσχον γυναῖκα αὐτὴν
verses.transliteration: oun en tē anastasei hē gynē tinos autōn gynē ginetai gar hoi hepta eschon gynaika autēn
verses.literal: So then in the resurrection - - whose . . . wife will she be For [all] seven vvv were married to her

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Οἱ υἱοὶ τούτου τοῦ αἰῶνος γαμοῦσιν καὶ γαμίσκονται
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Iēsous eipen autois Hoi huioi toutou tou aiōnos gamousin kai gamiskontai
verses.literal: - - Jesus answered . . . The sons of this - age marry and are given in marriage

verses.original: δὲ οἱ καταξιωθέντες τυχεῖν ἐκείνου τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ τῆς ἀναστάσεως τῆς ἐκ νεκρῶν οὔτε γαμοῦσιν οὔτε γαμίζονται
verses.transliteration: de hoi kataxiōthentes tychein ekeinou tou aiōnos kai tēs anastaseōs tēs ek nekrōn oute gamousin oute gamizontai
verses.literal: But those who are considered worthy to share in the age [to come] and in the resurrection - from [the] dead {will} neither marry nor be given in marriage

verses.original: γὰρ δύνανται οὐδὲ ἔτι ἀποθανεῖν γάρ εἰσιν ἰσάγγελοι καὶ ὄντες υἱοὶ τῆς ἀναστάσεως εἰσιν υἱοί Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar dynantai oude eti apothanein gar eisin isangeloi kai ontes huioi tēs anastaseōs eisin huioi Theou
verses.literal: In fact they can no longer die because they are like [the] angels And since they are sons of the resurrection they are sons of God

verses.original: δὲ καὶ Μωϋσῆς ἐμήνυσεν Ὅτι οἱ νεκροὶ ἐγείρονται ἐπὶ τῆς Βάτου ὡς λέγει Κύριον Τὸν Θεὸν Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Θεὸν Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Θεὸν Ἰακώβ
verses.transliteration: de kai Mōusēs emēnysen Hoti hoi nekroi egeirontai epi tēs Batou hōs legei Kyrion Ton Theon Abraam kai Theon Isaak kai Theon Iakōb
verses.literal: vvv Even Moses demonstrates that the dead are raised [ in the passage ] about the [ burning ] bush For he calls [the] Lord the God of Abraham - [the] God of Isaac and [the] God of Jacob

verses.original: δὲ ἔστιν οὐκ Θεὸς νεκρῶν ἀλλὰ ζώντων γὰρ αὐτῷ πάντες ζῶσιν
verses.transliteration: de estin ouk Theos nekrōn alla zōntōn gar autō pantes zōsin
verses.literal: - He is not [the] God of [the] dead but of [the] living for to Him all are alive

verses.original: δέ τινες τῶν γραμματέων Ἀποκριθέντες εἶπαν Διδάσκαλε εἶπας καλῶς
verses.transliteration: de tines tōn grammateōn Apokrithentes eipan Didaskale eipas kalōs
verses.literal: - Some of the scribes answered . . . Teacher You have spoken well

verses.original: γὰρ οὐκέτι ἐτόλμων ἐπερωτᾶν αὐτὸν οὐδέν
verses.transliteration: gar ouketi etolmōn eperōtan auton ouden
verses.literal: And vvv they did not dare to question Him any [further]

verses.original: δὲ Εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Πῶς λέγουσιν τὸν Χριστὸν εἶναι υἱόν Δαυὶδ
verses.transliteration: de Eipen pros autous Pōs legousin ton Christon einai huion Dauid
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] declared . . . . . . How can it be said that the Christ is [the] Son of David

verses.original: γὰρ Δαυὶδ αὐτὸς λέγει ἐν βίβλῳ ψαλμῶν Κύριος Εἶπεν μου τῷ Κυρίῳ Κάθου ἐκ μου δεξιῶν
verses.transliteration: gar Dauid autos legei en biblō psalmōn Kyrios Eipen mou tō Kyriō Kathou ek mou dexiōn
verses.literal: For David himself says in [the] book of Psalms [The] Lord said to my - Lord Sit at My right hand

verses.original: Ἕως ἂν θῶ σου τοὺς ἐχθρούς Ὑποπόδιον τῶν σου ποδῶν
verses.transliteration: Heōs an thō sou tous echthrous Hypopodion tōn sou podōn
verses.literal: until . . . I make Your - enemies a footstool for Your feet

verses.original: οὖν Δαυὶδ καλεῖ αὐτὸν Κύριον καὶ πῶς ἐστιν αὐτοῦ υἱός
verses.transliteration: oun Dauid kalei auton Kyrion kai pōs estin autou huios
verses.literal: Thus David calls Him Lord So how can He be [David’s] son

verses.original: Ἀκούοντος δὲ παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ εἶπεν τοῖς αὐτοῦ μαθηταῖς
verses.transliteration: Akouontos de pantos tou laou eipen tois autou mathētais
verses.literal: In the hearing - of all the people [Jesus] said to His disciples

verses.original: Προσέχετε ἀπὸ τῶν γραμματέων τῶν θελόντων περιπατεῖν ἐν στολαῖς καὶ φιλούντων ἀσπασμοὺς ἐν ταῖς ἀγοραῖς καὶ πρωτοκαθεδρίας ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς καὶ πρωτοκλισίας ἐν τοῖς δείπνοις
verses.transliteration: Prosechete apo tōn grammateōn tōn thelontōn peripatein en stolais kai philountōn aspasmous en tais agorais kai prōtokathedrias en tais synagōgais kai prōtoklisias en tois deipnois
verses.literal: Beware of the scribes - They like to walk around in long robes and they love [the] greetings in the marketplaces - [the] chief seats in the synagogues and [the] places of honor at - banquets

verses.original: οἳ κατεσθίουσιν τῶν χηρῶν τὰς οἰκίας καὶ προφάσει προσεύχονται μακρὰ οὗτοι λήμψονται περισσότερον κρίμα
verses.transliteration: hoi katesthiousin tōn chērōn tas oikias kai prophasei proseuchontai makra houtoi lēmpsontai perissoteron krima
verses.literal: [They] defraud - widows [of their] houses and for a show vvv make lengthy prayers These [men] will receive greater condemnation
